name: Ensapo JK ~Kuro Gyaru Bitch no Pichiman ni Tairyoushasei~
original_name: 援サポJK～黒ギャルビッチのピチマンに大量射精～
source:
Salaried worker Yoshio Imai was a salaryman in a deadend job.
He busted his butt every day, came home to nothing, no hobbies, no girlfriend.
Then his company sent him "on business" to another office.
It was a discrete form of demotion, but it came with a travel stipend.
Living in a hotel and feeling strangely liberated, he decided to try an escort...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE168320.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
上班族今井良夫被困在一份没有前途的工作里。
他每天拼命工作，回家后却一无所有：没有兴趣爱好，也没有女朋友。

随后，公司把他“出差”派往另一间办公室。这其实是一种隐蔽的降职，不过附带了出差津贴。

住在酒店里，感到莫名解脱的他决定尝试一次陪侍服务……
